items.html: Afterward, the sixth king reigned, which is Yesod, and it drew the generality of Gevurot into the Yesod of Tevuna, and the generality of Hassadim into the Yesod of Yisrael Saba. And when it died, these discernments descended as well. Afterward, the seventh king reigned, which is Malchut, in her vessel alone, and then she drew the generality of Hassadim into the Malchut of Yisrael Saba, and the generality of Gevurot into the Malchut of Tevuna. For Malchut, too, has a generality, in the manner explained above regarding Yesod, since it too is called Kalah [bride], just as Yesod is called Kol [all]. And when she died, the generality of Hassadim and Gevurot descended from the Malchut of Yisrael Saba and from the Malchut of Tevuna, and the vessel of Malchut descended to Beria. Now, too, all the posteriors of the four Partzufim of AVI, of Yisrael Saba and Tevuna, finished falling completely.
